title: extract-method
summary: Pulls a run of statements out of a routine into a new method
intro: Read this when a routine is too long and you want a run of statements moved into a new method without doing it by hand. Give the file, the first and last line and the new name; the usage lists --apply and --no-backup for writing the change.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint extract-method --file <F> --from-line <L1> --to-line <L2> --name <N> [--json|--apply|--no-backup] - pull a statement run into a new method
help: drag-lint extract-method --file <F> --from-line <L1> --to-line <L2> --name <N> [--json|--apply|--no-backup]  - pull a statement run into a new method
